This matters for correlation-id specifically: a brand new / already has a non-empty, auto-generated (seeded from 's root id, or a fresh GUID) before this interceptor ever runs — gating on "currently empty" would silently never apply an inbound header.
Registered automatically by , and runs inside so an exception it throws is still translated, symmetric to how propagation sits inside exception translation on the client.
